s2Description: A place for everything and everything in its place.
s3Description: Keep the work area clean and maintain it.
s4Description: Maintain and monitor the first three S's.
pendingCriteriaMessage: {{count}} criteria still need to be evaluated.
s1_material_innecesario_question: Is the area free of materials or objects that are not needed for the work?
s1_articulos_ajenos_question: Are items that don't belong to this area easily identified?
s1_material_obsoleto_defectuoso_question: Is there no obsolete, defective, or scrap material accumulated in the area?
s1_uso_frecuente_accesible_question: Are frequently used items accessible and within reach?
s1_sin_acumulaciones_question: Is unnecessary accumulation of materials or tools avoided?
s1_identificacion_visual_question: Is visual identification (tags, labels) used for items under review?
s1_espacio_disponible_question: Is there enough available space, free of obstructions from unnecessary items?
s1_elementos_por_remover_question: Are items that should be removed from the area detected and marked?
s2_ubicacion_definida_question: Does every material/tool have a defined location?
s2_identificacion_ubicaciones_question: Are locations identified with labels or signs?
s2_herramientas_acomodadas_question: Are tools arranged in an orderly way?
s2_punto_de_uso_question: Are materials located at their point of use?
s2_senalizacion_question: Is there signage or floor marking where it applies?
s2_articulos_juntos_question: Are items used together stored together?
s2_facilidad_encontrar_devolver_question: Is it easy to find what's needed and return it to its place after use?
s2_sin_objetos_fuera_de_lugar_question: Are there no items out of their assigned place?
s3_equipos_estaciones_limpios_question: Are equipment and work stations clean?
s3_sin_residuos_question: Is there no accumulated waste or trash?
s3_sin_polvo_suciedad_question: Is there no visible dust or dirt?
s3_sin_contaminantes_question: Are there no oil spills, burrs, or other contaminants?
s3_condiciones_anormales_question: Are there no visible abnormal conditions (leaks, loose cables, etc.)?
s3_responsabilidad_limpieza_question: Are cleaning responsibilities for the area visible and known?
s4_estandares_visuales_question: Are there clear visual standards for the area?
s4_responsabilidades_asignadas_question: Are responsibilities for maintaining order assigned?
s4_senalizacion_estandarizada_question: Does signage follow a consistent standard?
s4_instrucciones_visibles_question: Are instructions or procedures visible in the area?
s4_checklist_seguimiento_question: Is there a checklist or follow-up mechanism?
s4_identificacion_consistente_question: Is visual identification consistent throughout the area?
s4_mantenimiento_123_question: Are the conditions achieved in Sort, Set in Order and Shine maintained?
s4_estandares_faciles_question: Are the standards easy for anyone to understand?
s5_cumplimiento_continuo_question: Is there continuous day-to-day compliance with 5S?
s5_disciplina_question: Is staff discipline observed in maintaining order?
s5_participacion_empleados_question: Do employees actively participate in maintaining 5S?
s5_entrenamiento_question: Has staff received training in the 5S methodology?
s5_habitos_5s_question: Are 5S habits observed as part of the daily routine?
s5_soporte_liderazgo_question: Is there visible support from the area leader/owner?
s5_seguimiento_auditorias_anteriores_que: Were findings from previous audits followed up on?
s5_sostenimiento_mejoras_question: Are the improvements achieved sustained over time?
